(B − A) ÷ (B + A)，用于检查位置偏好: (B − A) / (B + A), for checking location bias
(新 − 旧) ÷ (新 + 旧)；训练阶段为 (B − A) ÷ (B + A: (Novel − familiar) / (novel + familiar); the training phase uses (B − A) / (B + A) for side bias.
(社交 − 物体) ÷ (社交 + 物体)，按嗅探时间计算；新颖性阶段为 (新: (Social − object) / (social + object), based on investigation time; novelty phase uses (novel − familiar) / (novel + familiar).
0 = 各方向均匀；越大越偏向某一方向: 0 = uniform directional occupancy; higher values indicate directional bias
0° = 场地右方（左上 → 右上角方向），逆时针为正: 0° = arena right (top-left to top-right), positive counterclockwise

Barnes 迷宫的“错误”定义是把鼻子探进非目标洞，这是鼻尖行为，质心追踪无法: In the Barnes maze, an error is a nose probe into a non-target hole. This is a nose-specific behavior that centroid tracking cannot reliably count.
C 对准中央，N / E / S / W 拖到四个臂的末端；青色为开放臂。: Place C at the center and N / E / S / W at the arm tips; cyan denotes open arms.

CSV 为 UTF-8（带 BOM），Excel 可直接打开中文。列名为英文，便: CSV files use UTF-8 with BOM for Excel compatibility. Column headers remain in English for Python / R.
HD 占据分布的平均向量长度，越接近 0 越均匀；偏大时调谐曲线容易受采样偏差影: Mean vector length of head-direction occupancy; values nearer zero indicate more uniform sampling.
HD 细胞记录配套 · 头朝向占据与角速度: Head-direction physiology · Direction occupancy and angular velocity
IdPhi = 通过选择点期间朝向变化绝对值之和: IdPhi = sum of absolute orientation changes at the choice point
J 为三臂交汇中心，A / B / C 为三个臂末端: J marks the junction; A / B / C mark the three arm tips.
J 为选择点，S 为起始臂末端，L / R 为左右臂末端: J marks the choice point, S the start arm, and L / R the left and right arms.
J 对准三臂交汇中心，A / B / C 拖到三个臂的末端。: Place J at the three-arm junction and A / B / C at the arm tips.
J 对准选择点，S 为起始臂末端，L / R 为左右臂末端。: Place J at the choice point, S at the start arm, and L / R at left and right arm tips.
N / E / S / W 为标定时的四个臂末端: N / E / S / W are the calibrated arm ends
VTE 本质是头部扫视。RodentStudio 直接用头朝向计算 IdPhi，: VTE involves head scanning. RodentStudio computes IdPhi from head direction and provides a trajectory-based IdPhi for comparison, together with left/right choices and alternation.
一只鼠的鼻尖到另一只鼠尾根 < 2.5 cm（A→B、B→A 分开统计）。: Nose-to-tail-base distance < 2.5 cm, reported separately for A→B and B→A.
三条臂互成 120°，动物自由探索约 8 min。连续三次进入三条不同的臂记为一: Three arms meet at 120°. The animal explores freely for about 8 minutes. Visiting all three arms in three successive entries counts as an alternation; alternation rate is alternations / (entries − 2).
不做范式分析，只输出逐帧关键点和派生运动学（速度、头朝向、身体轴向等），用于自己: Exports framewise keypoints and derived kinematics (speed, head direction, body axis, etc.) without assay-specific analysis, for custom workflows such as Keypoint-MoSeq, B-SOiD or SimBA.
不含刺激时已在巢内的试次: Excluding trials already in shelter at onset
不标定时坐标为像素；标定后额外输出厘米坐标: Without calibration, coordinates are pixels; calibration also provides centimeter coordinates.
不标定时，坐标、距离和速度以像素为单位。: Without calibration, coordinates, distance and speed are measured in pixels.
不超过这个时长的缺失按线性插值补齐；更长的缺口保持缺失。: Gaps up to this length are filled by linear interpolation; longer gaps stay missing.
两侧嗅探总时间不足 5 s，指数可能不稳定。: Total investigation time across sides was under 5 s; the index may be unstable.
两只小鼠在同一场地自由互动，例如青少年社交、居住者-入侵者测试中的非攻击部分、雌: Two freely moving mice interact in one arena, for example in juvenile social interactions, nonaggressive resident–intruder behavior or male–female interaction. Readouts include sniffing and following bouts and duration.
两只自由活动小鼠 · 鼻对鼻、肛殖区嗅探、跟随: Two freely moving mice · Nose-to-nose, anogenital sniffing, following
两只鼠体色相同时，身体紧贴重叠后身份可能交换；建议毛色或标记区分: When mice look alike, identities may swap after overlap; distinguish them by coat or safe marking when possible.
两条开放臂与两条闭合臂交叉的高架迷宫，通常测 5 min。开放臂时间和进入次数比: An elevated maze with two open and two closed arms, commonly tested for 5 min. Reduced open-arm time and entry fractions are often interpreted as more anxiety-like behavior.
两耳中点 → 鼻尖向量的方向；0° = 画面右方（或提示卡方向），逆时针为正。: Direction of the ear-midpoint-to-nose vector; 0° is image right (or cue direction), counterclockwise positive.
中央区时间 %、进入次数、首次进入潜伏期。: Percent center time, entries and first-entry latency.
中央区默认为场地边长的 50%，可在参数中调整: The default center region spans 50% of the arena side length; adjust in parameters.
也可直接拖动视频上的两条中箱边界（紫色 L/R 控制点），分别调整位置和宽度。: You can also drag the two center-chamber boundaries (purple L/R handles) independently to adjust their positions and the chamber width.
互动区（网罩周围）与对侧两个角落区: Interaction zone around enclosure and two opposite corner zones
仅导出姿态，没有范式参数。: Pose-only export has no assay-specific parameters.
从透明底部仰拍时画面左右镜像，打开后同侧 / 对侧按动物自身方向换算。: Filming from below through a clear floor mirrors left and right; turn this on so that ipsilateral and contralateral follow the animal's own sides.
以目标洞为中心 ±45° 扇区内的时间比例（探索测试）。: Fraction of time in the ±45° sector centered on the target hole (probe trial).
以鼻尖探洞计错误数 · 潜伏期与路径: Nose-based hole investigation · Errors, latency and path
会保存在这个范式的常用列表中。: It is saved to this paradigm's list.
会话内 z 标准化；zIdPhi ≥ 0.5 记为 VTE（阈值可调）。: Within-session z-scoring; zIdPhi ≥ 0.5 is classified as VTE (adjustable).
传统方法要在头上装两个 LED。RodentStudio 用两耳中点 → 鼻尖的: Traditional head-direction tracking may use two LEDs on the head. RodentStudio estimates direction from the ear midpoint → nose vector (fallback neck → nose) without markers, and exports timestamped HD and angular head velocity for alignment with electrophysiology or calcium imaging.
位置细胞、网格细胞记录通常让动物在开放场地中觅食数十分钟。分析放电野之前要先看占: Place-cell and grid-cell experiments often record animals for tens of minutes in open arenas. Before estimating firing fields, inspect occupancy uniformity and coverage and remove immobile periods using a speed threshold such as > 2 cm/s.
低于此置信度的关键点视为缺失。调高更严格（缺失更多），调低会保留更多不确定的点。: Keypoints below this confidence are treated as missing. Higher is stricter (more missing points); lower keeps more uncertain points.
依次拖动 C（中心）和 N / E / S / W 四个臂末端: Place C at the center and N / E / S / W at the four arm tips.
保留原始逐帧关键点（像素坐标、置信度），同时附带标定后的厘米坐标和派生特征。: Retain raw framewise keypoints (pixel coordinates and confidence) alongside calibrated centimeter coordinates and derived features.
修改阈值或区域后，结果会立即重新计算，不需要重新识别。: Changing a threshold or zone recalculates the results immediately; the model does not need to run again.
俯拍、画面包含整个场地、光照均匀；红外 / 灰度视频效果最好。: Film from directly above, capture the whole arena, and use even illumination. Grayscale or infrared video is preferred.
停留 ≥ 0.2 s 的方格占场地方格的比例，以及随时间的增长曲线。: Fraction of spatial bins with ≥ 0.2 s occupancy, plus its growth over time.
停留时间 ≥ 1 s 的方向格所占比例。: Fraction of direction bins with dwell time ≥ 1 s.
先在“识别”页运行模型。: Run the model on the Detect page first.
公认的“探索”定义是鼻尖距物体 ≤ 2 cm 且头朝向物体，爬到物体上或背对物体: A common operational definition of object investigation requires the nose to be within 2 cm of the object and facing it, excluding climbing or sitting beside it. A centroid-radius approach can overcount passing or nearby inactivity.
关键点运动 < 1 cm/s 持续 ≥ 1 s 的时间。: Duration of keypoint movement < 1 cm/s sustained for ≥ 1 s.
分析时间段内没有检测到探入目标洞。: No target-hole investigation was detected during the analysis window.
分析时间段内的帧太少，请检查“分析起点 / 时长”是否超出了已识别的范围。: Too few frames in the analysis window. Check whether the start time and duration extend beyond detected frames.
分析时间段（例如只看前 5 分钟）可以在“标定”页随时调整，不需要重新识别。: The analysis window (e.g., only the first 5 minutes) can be changed at any time on the Calibrate step without running the model again.
切到后台会自动暂停，已识别的部分会保存，回来后可继续。: Detection pauses automatically in the background and saves progress; resume when you return.
切换语言后界面会立即更新。: The interface updates immediately after changing the language.
刺激出现时的头朝向和到巢穴的方向决定了逃跑路径，是这个范式的重要协变量。Rode: Head direction relative to shelter at stimulus onset can influence escape paths. RodentStudio reports the head-to-shelter angle for each stimulus.
刺激后 10 s 内的僵直时长（同恐惧条件化的定义）。: Freezing duration during 10 s after stimulus (same definition as fear conditioning).
刺激后速度首次超过 max(4 × 基线速度, 15 cm/s) 的时间。: Time until speed first exceeds max(4× baseline speed, 15 cm/s) after stimulus.
刺激时头朝向与巢穴方向的夹角、到巢穴的距离。: Angle between head direction and shelter direction at stimulation, plus distance to shelter.
前 20 s 探索的 DI: DI during first 20 s of investigation
动物在选择点停下，头部在两侧之间来回摆动，称为替代性试错（VTE），反映决策时的: At choice points, animals sometimes pause and scan between alternatives, a behavior known as vicarious trial and error (VTE). A common measure is IdPhi, the cumulative absolute change in orientation during the choice, z-scored within a session.
动物头顶的屏幕呈现快速扩大的黑色圆盘（模拟俯冲的捕食者），小鼠通常在一秒内逃回庇: A rapidly expanding dark disk overhead mimics an approaching predator and can evoke rapid shelter-directed escape or freezing. Metrics include response latency, shelter return, escape speed and freezing.
单侧损伤或其他单侧操作后，动物常表现出偏向一侧的旋转。按身体轴向统计同侧与对侧整: After a unilateral lesion or another one-sided manipulation, animals often turn preferentially toward one side. Full ipsilateral and contralateral turns are counted from the body axis; net rotations quantify the left–right asymmetry or compare experimental conditions.
单侧损伤模型 · 同侧 / 对侧整圈数: Unilateral lesion models · Ipsilateral / contralateral full turns
占据图、覆盖度与速度 · 神经记录同步: Occupancy, coverage and speed · Neural recording alignment
只保存在本机，会随汇总表一起导出。: Stored on this device only; included in the summary table export.
只有 %.0f%% 的帧同时检出两只鼠；双鼠贴近或重叠时可能漏检或身份交换。: Both mice were detected in only %.0f%% of frames; close contact or overlap can cause missed detections or identity swaps.
只统计这段时间；不影响已识别的数据: Analyze only this period; saved detections are unchanged.
可在 iPhone 设置中选择 RodentStudio 的首选语言；如果未显示: Choose RodentStudio’s preferred language in iPhone Settings. If no per-app option appears, change the system’s preferred language.
可选，也可以不选。轻点 + 添加自己的标签（如 Day 1、Baseline 或: Optional. Tap + to add your own label (e.g., Day 1, Baseline, or any experimental condition); it stays available for this paradigm. Long-press one of your labels to remove it. Tap a selected label again to clear the selection.
可选：把 Q 手柄拖到墙上的提示卡，作为参考方向: Optional: drag Q to a wall-mounted cue card to set the direction reference.
同一批实验的第一只鼠认真标定，之后的视频会自动沿用。: Calibrate the first mouse of a batch carefully; later sessions can reuse that setup.
同一编号的无目标 / 有目标两次测试: Paired target-absent and target-present tests for the same subject
同侧 − 对侧，及每分钟净旋转数和分段曲线。: Ipsilateral − contralateral rotations, net turns per minute and binned trends.
四周留出空间，让探头时鼻尖仍在画面内: Leave enough margin so the nose remains visible during head dips.
圆形平台边缘有一圈洞，只有目标洞下有逃逸箱。动物借助墙上的空间线索学习目标位置。: The Barnes maze has a ring of holes, with an escape box under the target hole. Animals learn its location using distal spatial cues. Metrics include target latency, errors, path length and target-quadrant time in probe trials.
在“回看”中抽查骨架和行为判定，必要时调整阈值。: Spot-check poses and behavior calls in Review, and adjust thresholds if needed.
在参数里输入 CS 开始时间（相对于视频开头）和时长: Enter CS onset times (relative to video start) and durations.
在参数里选择陌生鼠（或新陌生鼠）所在的一侧: Select the side containing the stranger (or novel stranger) in parameters.
基线（首个 CS 前）、每个 CS 期间、CS 间隔的僵直百分比。: Freezing percentages before first CS, during each CS, and between CS events.
声音（CS）与足底电击配对后，在相同情境或新情境中重放 CS，测量僵直（除呼吸外: Following pairing of an auditory conditioned stimulus (CS) with footshock, the CS is replayed in the original or a new context to quantify freezing (immobility except breathing).
头朝向 = 两耳中点 → 鼻尖；身体轴向 = 尾根 → 颈部；身体长度 = 鼻尖: Head direction = ear midpoint → nose; body axis = tail base → neck; body length = nose → tail base.
头朝向占据明显不均匀（平均向量长度 %.2f），计算调谐曲线时务必按占据归一化。: Head-direction occupancy is nonuniform (mean vector length %.2f); normalize tuning curves by occupancy.
头朝向对时间的导数（°/s），以及顺 / 逆时针转头时间。: Derivative of head direction over time (°/s) and duration of clockwise/counterclockwise turning.
头顶扩张黑影 → 逃回巢穴或僵直: Overhead expanding shadow → Escape or freezing
姿态数据和结果会保留，可以继续调整参数、导出；但无法再回看视频或重新识别。: Pose data and results are kept; you can still adjust parameters and export, but video review and reprocessing will be unavailable.
姿态数据文件已损坏或版本不兼容: Pose data file is corrupted or incompatible
实验数据始终以英文保存和导出，不受界面语言影响。: Experimental data is always stored and exported in English, regardless of interface language.
实验条件可在“信息”页用 + 添加为自定义标签: Add experimental conditions as your own labels with + on the Info step
实验鼠在三个相连的箱室中自由探索，两侧各放一个铁丝杯。社交偏好阶段一侧杯内是陌生: A test mouse explores three connected chambers with wire cups in the side chambers. In the sociability phase, one cup holds a stranger and the other is empty or contains an object; in social novelty, a familiar mouse is contrasted with a new stranger. Readouts include chamber dwell times and cup investigation.
工作记忆 · 交替率与探头未进入: Working memory · Alternation and partial entries
左 / 右选择、连续选择的交替率、选择点停留时间。: Left/right choice, alternation rate and time spent at the choice point.
左滑可删除整次分析，或只删除视频副本（保留姿态数据与结果，但无法再回看视频）。: Swipe left to delete a session, or delete only its video copy (pose data and results remain, but video review is unavailable).
左滑或长按可删除整次分析，或只删除视频副本（保留姿态数据与结果，但无法再回看视频: Swipe left or touch and hold to delete a session, or delete only its video copy (pose data and results remain, but video review is unavailable).
已暂停：已识别的部分已保存，可以随时继续。: Paused: processed frames have been saved; you can resume anytime.
已沿用上一个同类视频的标定、参数和组别。若摄像头位置变了，请在“标定”中检查手柄: Calibration, parameters and group were copied from the previous similar session. If the camera moved, check handles in Calibration.
平滑后坐标（cm）、速度、头朝向、区域与行为标记: Smoothed coordinates (cm), speed, head direction, zones and behavior labels
平滑后的坐标、速度、头朝向、身体轴向、头–身夹角、身体长度。: Smoothed coordinates, speed, head direction, body heading, head–body angle and body length.
开放臂探索 + 探头 + 伸展评估姿势: Open-arm exploration, head dips and stretch-attend posture
开放臂时间 ÷（开放臂 + 闭合臂时间）。: Time in open arms / time in open plus closed arms.
开放臂进入 ÷ 总进入；默认身体中心和尾根都进入臂才算。: Open-arm entries / total entries; by default body center and tail base must enter an arm.
彩色点为嗅探时的鼻尖位置；虚线圈为嗅探判定范围: Colored points mark nose positions during investigation; dashed rings show the criterion radius.
总探索时间 %.1f s，不足 20 s（许多研究以此作为纳入标准）。: Total investigation time %.1f s was below 20 s (an inclusion criterion used by some studies).
总路程、平均运动速度、速度分布。: Total path length, mean movement speed and speed distribution.
慢性社会挫败后的社交回避 · SI ratio: Social avoidance after chronic social defeat · SI ratio
慢性社会挫败应激（CSDS）模型的标准读数。实验鼠在旷场中探索两次，每次 150: A standard readout for chronic social defeat stress (CSDS). The mouse explores an open arena in two 150 s trials: first with an empty enclosure, then with an unfamiliar aggressor behind it. Interaction-zone dwell time is compared; SI ratio < 1 is commonly used as a susceptibility cutoff.
所有视频、姿态数据和结果只保存在本机，可在“文件”App › 我的 iPhone: All videos, pose data, and results remain on-device. Find them in Files › On My iPhone › RodentStudio › Sessions. Each analysis has its own folder: session.json (settings and metrics), pose.mpt (framewise keypoints), and video.* (video copy).

把手柄恢复到默认位置？: Reset calibration handles to their default positions?

拖动对齐；也可用操作菜单微调位置: Drag to align, or use the actions to nudge the position
拖动时对侧上角会出现放大镜；VoiceOver 用户可在操作菜单中逐步微调手柄。: While you drag, a magnifier appears in the opposite top corner. VoiceOver users can nudge handles step by step from the actions menu.

指标、参数、标定、质量与方法说明: Metrics, parameters, calibration, quality and methods
按身体轴向累计的完整顺时针 / 逆时针转圈数。: Full clockwise / counterclockwise rotations accumulated from body orientation.
探头时身体在中央区或闭合臂: Body in center or closed arm during head dip
摄像头尽量正上方俯拍，画面包含整个场地，光照均匀: Film from directly overhead, with the entire arena visible and uniform lighting.
新建一次分析后，结果会出现在这里。: Create an analysis to see its results here.
方向覆盖度只有 %.0f%%：部分方向采样不足，调谐曲线在这些方向上不可靠。: Directional coverage is only %.0f%%; tuning curves may be unreliable in undersampled directions.
旋转计数需要身体轴向（尾根 → 颈部）。RodentStudio 对轴向角度累计: Counting rotations needs body heading (tail base → neck). RodentStudio accumulates complete 360° turns, including small in-place turns, without a rotometer.
无目标、有目标两个阶段分别建立分析，编号相同即可自动配对: Analyze target-absent and target-present phases separately under the same subject ID to pair results automatically.
明亮的大箱与黑暗的小箱通过小门相连，测 5–10 min。明箱时间和穿梭次数反映: The light–dark box has bright and dark compartments linked by a doorway, commonly tested for 5–10 min. Light-side time and transitions are measures of anxiety-like behavior.
明箱时间、穿梭 + 探头风险评估: Light-compartment time, transitions and head pokes
明箱路程占比: Fraction of distance on light side
曲线趋于平台说明采样基本充分: A plateau indicates sampling may be sufficient.
最初 10 cm 移动方向与目标方向的夹角: Angle between initial 10 cm movement and target direction
最常用的自发活动与焦虑样行为测试：动物在方形或圆形场地中自由探索 5–30 mi: The open-field test is a widely used measure of spontaneous locomotion and anxiety-like behavior. The mouse freely explores a square or circular arena for 5–30 min; readouts include total distance, center time and center entries.
有反应且在 10 s 内回到巢穴区。: Behavioral response followed by return to shelter within 10 s.
有效范围 %@–%@，已按边界值计算: Valid range %@–%@; the nearest limit is used

质心追踪只知道动物“在哪里”。鼻尖、两耳、颈部、身体中心和尾根六个关键点还能回答: Centroid tracking tells you where an animal is. Six landmarks—nose, ears, neck, body center and tail base—also help estimate its orientation and actions, including investigation, risk assessment, turning and immobility. These assays use literature-inspired definitions with adjustable thresholds.
